label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Two blocking popups (a shipping-to-[name] country modal and a cookie banner) appear at the very top of the tree and focus is not placed in them; I had to find the buttons by name to decline them.
The country modal Welcome we ship to spain stays announced as page content after the cookie banner is closed, and I only got rid of it by finding stay on this site.
Many product links and images are unlabeled or read as a dash, and image names contain code fragments like angle brackets and product codes, which is noisy and confusing.

Every product has the same Add to cart button name that differs only by price, and some products show only a shade name like 5N or Retailer AN as heading, so I could not tell which product a button belongs to.
After adding to cart the bag opened saying cart 0 items and your cart is empty, and only a later re-read showed 1 item; there was no announcement that the item was added.
